notes.title: Version 0.39 and the "Squadrons" Update - Dev Blog
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11885942/e34cb93a36c503784c8cd66af98df7c48f45eb0c.png[/img]


Greetings pilots! Rayne here with another dev blog, this time, as promised, we're going to be going over what's changing in update 0.39....


0.39, or "Squadrons" as we're calling it, adds the first pass off the squadron/deck building system to the game, as well as new mechanics such as the inability to switch teams during game-play, repair and rearm and timers for those features, and a host of bug fixes and improvements including a UI back-end replacement.

Let's get started shall we?

Firstly, when you log in for the first time post 0.39, you will be welcomed with the new lobby screen, in this screen, you can see your currently active Squadron, highlighted in orange, and buttons for Editing the Squadron and Changing the Active Squadron. You'll also see the "Create New Battle" button  which will allow you to start a new match. The way matches are made now has changed.
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11885942/9c4f5c42dd3739a0365fa348151b32fa6203a211.jpg[/img]

In this screen, you can see that when you go to create a new battle, the match you can start is limited to the "Generations" of your current squadron. In this example, your squadron is Generation 1 and 2 helicopters, and can fight on both of our Viet Nam maps. As a note, when you go to join a  match in progress, the same rules apply. You'll see the Icon that denotes generation access as well as text that says "Helicopters of Generation "number" fight on this map." 
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11885942/d7ef468afcd1442188a1f036ca830abcf2d33f92.jpg[/img]

When you enter a match, you are now greated with a "Selection" screen that shows your squadron as it stands, including repair timers that might also be on them should you need to respawn or repair them.
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11885942/d83fc8f508320ce3afe361524ada211ae93574d3.jpg[/img]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11885942/81319e16aca0558de7f2d517121d2f0a69924912.jpg[/img]

To leave a helicopter for repair, if it has not yet been shot down, simply land back at base and press "G" this brings up the selection screen, showing you the repair timer for all helos in your squadron that are being repaired. The more damage you have, the longer this process will take. Think of it like leaving the helo with the mechanics to perform field maintenance.

Also new in the update, is soldier replacement and weapon reloading also take time based on the number of soldiers, and the ammount and types of weapons. We're hoping to add a deeper level of tactical gameplay here. The risks you take with your aircraft, your men, and the weapons you use will have an effect when you return to base. So keep this in mind!

Now, on to the squadron system itself. When you click "edit squadron" you will be brought to the following screen,
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11885942/9e60e1bd8e4d98ae362112deca77c9373a67a080.jpg[/img]

Here you can see several pieces of information,
-The point value for your helo in it's current configuration in gold with a star directly above the helo.
-The Helicopter itself (camera is being reworked)
-The nation Icon on the bottom left and the Generation Icon on the bottom right.
-The total point value of the squadron
-The "Generation Lock" which shows you that this squadron can fight in Generation 1 and Generation 2 battles, but 3 and 4 are of limits. Notced by the orange highlight and greyed out buttons.

Now, when you click on a helicopter in the selection list, you will get the following screen,
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11885942/58a0bb20857dc158ea9edc1f5f1e3b769c0b4067.jpg[/img]

Here, you can see the "Flight Qualities" overview. This shows the stats of the helo, the name, basic info etc. What you should pay attention to is the different point costs for changing the loadout. As you can see in the above with the Mi-24A, it's stock loadout is 11 points and the upgraded loadout costs 12. You can also see in the above screen that we let you go pretty wild with your squadron names, as well as the button to "add" the helo to the current squadron up in the top left. Simply type in the name and hit enter, and you're done. As for the troopers button? That gets you here,
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11885942/bc49c680fe3fcfd4feb57a6ad056841328288921.jpg[/img]

With this menu, you can raise and lower the normal ammount of regular soldiers, or add more "Special Operations Units" such as MANPAD's, RPG/SMAW, and (coming soon) Mortar Troops. These units will raise the cost of the helicopter when you add it to the squadron as a note, so keep that in mind if you want to bring a chinook with uber troopers for map control. Now, just a small note here, that this feature is currently disabled, though it will be unlocked when we get the new soldier model in the game. So, just stay tuned, it's coming, I promise!

So, that's about it folks. That's the overview as it stands. As stated in the previous blog, you can play with all this by accessing the beta branch via the properties menu > beta tab. 

We are hoping to have this fully operational in a week or two and on the live game for those that would rather not deal with a beta, or those that are waiting for this update.

We'll keep you updated on the condition of the beta as the week moves on. Feel free to reply with any questions and comments and feedback as a whole. We'll get to it! Also, join the discussion on the steam forums or our home forums.

Thank you all again for your support and patience.
-Rayne
Community Manger
JetCat Games

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11885942/1e6fbb3e9f91e3c166a094134f51653de756a7c4.png[/img]

notes.title: Tell us all the things!
notes.notes:
[img]http://www.jetcatgames.com/wp-content/uploads/2015/07/logo_temp1.png[/img]

[b]Greetings pilots![/b]
Firstly, we'd like to reach out yet again to all our great players that are helping us make heliborne great and giving us that much valued feedback. Without you all, we wouldn't be here and we realise that, and starting next week, we're going to be making strides to show you! How you might ask? Well, read below...

[b]On 0.38[/b]
Update 0.38 is progressing, and we should have it out on Thursday. Hopefully this gives us a few days after the update to get hotfixes out and quick changes out should anything break. As I said in the last announcement, there's a lot of mechanical changes coming to heliborne, a lot of new code, and gameplay et all, and while we try our best to make sure the patches we give you are spotless, this one might have some issues pop up. Rest assured, Team JetCat will be on hand all day to hear you feedback and make changes as soon as any issues crop up.

[b]On Future Updates[/b]
In regards to future updates, there might be some changes coming to the frequencey of the update cycle. As many of you have no doubt noticed, we've had to delay the weekly updates quite a few times lately. There's a myriad number of valid reasons for this, from large code changes, to integrating new team members, etc However, we feel it might be better if we move to a two-week update schedule from here on out so that we can provide patches that are more stable, as well as having more content in them. The next few updates are planned to be large, and with our goal to get Heliborne to a released state by December..we need to make sure the content we're putting out is on par. We'd like to hear you feedback on this! 

[b]On future Updates Part Deux..[/b]
Outside the update schedule I mentioned above, with a two week schedule, you can expect several more updates to the game before we shoot for a "release canadate". So, what can you expect to be coming over the following months?

[img]http://80.lv/wp-content/uploads/2015/08/2015-08-14-18-21-15-Heliborne-Tactical-helicopter-mulitplayer-arcade-Google-Chrome.png[/img]
Squadron/Deck building - This is the big one people have been waiting for, and it's coming! We're shooting for 0.39-0.40 area for this as there's a lot to it. 0.38 is adding a lot of the ground work for this system as was mentioned in my earlier update letter that was out earlier this week. With this first pass on this system you'll have 3 Slots to work with, and helicopters will cost points to field based on several factors. This system will be a first pass, so that means we can, and may change it with your feedback. 

[b]What else is coming?[/b]
[list]
[*]A new flight model, alongside changes in the base flight model adding things like "weight" as well as "crash situations" such as autorotation, crash landings, etc
[*]A fully featured stats tracking system that will keep you up to date on flight times, kills, deaths, etc
[*]New ground unit behavior
[*]New soldier types, such as the mortar team
[*]Reworked recon helicopter systems and gameplay
[/list]

This isn't all of it, but it's the start and a lot of it you can expect over the next few months. We hope you like these new features, and look forward to your feedback.


[b]For the community...[/b]
So, big announcement! JetCatgames is going to be at the following events,
[list]
[*]Digital Dragons - Poland - 16th and 17th of May
[*]Gamescom - Germany - 18th to the 21st of August
[*]EGX - London - 22nd to the 25th of September
[/list]

You can expect to see us at these events if you're in Europe, so stop by our booths and say hi! play the game, talk with us directly, etc! 

[b]As to our North American Friends,[/b]
You can expect to see me, aka "Rayne" at the Vectren Dayton International Airshow in Dayton Ohio on the 18th and 19th of June. I'll be hanging around the US Army Aviation Heritage Foundation's set up, which just so happens to have several AH-1 Cobra's and UH-1 Huey's that are still flying and that you can get rides on! That and spending time around the airshow proper. I'll be sure and get you more information on how to meet up with me directly before the show.

[b]What else can you expect community wise outside all that?[/b] 
 Join us on www.twitch.tv/jetcatgames for live Q and A sessions with guests, and gameplay during Digital Dragons on the 16th and 17th of May. 

We'll be moving to a weekly live stream schedule after this initial stream, so stay tuned for more!

Also, Team JetCat is happy to annuonce that we'll be hosting tournaments over the coming months with what we think are pretty amazing prizes, such as a large scale RC helicopter, custom artwork, in-game helo skins, and more! More info on this is coming in future update letters!
[img]http://www.scaleflying.com/assets/images/02-ah-1w-stbd-side.jpg[/img]

Well folks, that's about it. Just some quick notes for you. Hope you enjoyed this little letter and all the info in it. Feel free to ask questions and keep the feedback coming!
-Rayne
Team JetCat

[img]http://i.imgur.com/xDuV5t6.png[/img]

notes.title: 0.38 Delay - This is a big one folks!
notes.notes:
[img]http://www.jetcatgames.com/wp-content/uploads/2015/07/logo_temp1.png[/img]

Greetings pilots! We've a lot to talk about today so let's get started shall we?

First and foremost, is that the next update is going to take a few extra days to get ready. Why, you might ask? Well, because there's a bit going in to it that we need a few more days to polish and get working right. What's coming exactly? Take a look,

[b]Era Spread Changes Coming - These changes are WIP and may not be final[/b]

We've decided to move from a 3-era spread, to a 4-era spread to help balance the game, maps, and vehicles easier. This means that we'll be moving to this spread,

Tier 1 - 1950-1960
Tier 2 - 1960-1970
Tier 3 - 1970-1980
Tier 4 - 1990+

As we test this spread, we'll be looking to see if it's to short a year range, if we should add more tiers, go back to three tiers instead, etc. We'll need your feedback on balance changes, and we're going to be on standby to make changes as soon as we get said feedback.

[img]http://corrdefense.nace.org/CorrDefense_Fall_2006/images/Two-Choppers.jpg[/img]
Now, gameplay wise...say helo to the new repair and re-arm system,

First, we're adding new respawn timers when you're shot down. We'll be looking for feedback on the lengths of downed time here as well. You'll be able to land a helicopter at a bas and have it be repaired and this will take time depending on the amount of damage. On top of this, we're adding timers to reloading based on your weapons load out. Have a chopper with missiles? Easy reload. Have one loaded to crap and back with rockets, MG's, missiles, et all? You should expect to need time to re-arm and get back in the fight.

Heat seekers are also getting another pass that will change how hard it is to lock on to a target. Flares are also going to become more effecitve at shorter ranges. Finally, you can also expect the standard round of bug fixes, performance enhancements, etc.

Feel free to give feedback in the comments section below!
-Rayne
Team Jet Cat

[img]http://i.imgur.com/xDuV5t6.png[/img]

notes.title: 0.36 Delay - Technical Problems Arise
notes.notes:
[img]http://www.jetcatgames.com/wp-content/uploads/2015/07/logo_temp1.png[/img]
Greetings Pilots! Rayne here with an update on 0.36 and some new images for the upcoming new map.

[img]http://i.imgur.com/aWQA5uD.jpg[/img]
It seems like I've had to do this a few times as of late, and for that, we'd like to be as transparent as possible and apologize for the patch delays. I myself was on a much needed vacation, and with the integration of new team members, and updates to the games base code we've had a few small technical issues crop up that are forcing us to delay 0.36. This delay should be no more than a day, but if it is, rest assured that you will hear from us if we have to extend the delay period.

[img]http://i.imgur.com/ZGnopzi.jpg[/img]
On a good note, we've written entirely new ground unit behavior for the new upcoming map, and if it works well, you'll see all the maps updated with this new behavior. What is the new behavior you might ask? Ground units will no longer stop outright when they've deployed from an LZ, if they encounter other ground forces, they will engage them. We hope this adds another small layer of immersion to the game to have ground units engaging one another while you're flying over them on the new map.

[img]http://i.imgur.com/hiMmsow.jpg[/img]
Outside 0.36 and the changes and features it will be adding, I'd also like to report that the new team members are all integrated now and working with us to get new helos, maps, and game features in faster than we've been able to do in the past. I'm afraid I still don't have an update on the deck building system, but stay tuned for more because it is coming!


We'd like to thank you all for your continued support, patience, and understanding.
-Rayne
[img] http://i.imgur.com/xDuV5t6.png [/img]

- New helicopter - The AH-1J / AH-1J TOW International has been added
- All rockets and missiles now have their own models and textures
- ATGM's were fixed on some helicopters (Mi-1MU, OH-13S, and several others), they are now faster in flight.
- FFAR and Hydra rockets are now two different kinds of rockets, FFAR have a lower blast radius than Hydra rockets.
- Air-to-Air rockets now have bigger proximity detonation radius and a bit bigger lock-on sector
- There is now 'Rear view' button, which is X by default
- Hangar camera is updated, you can zoom in more now
- ATGM's are now harder to aim when moving
- Textures on several helicopters are updated
- Some small bug fixes

notes.title: 0.33 Is live!
notes.notes:
This update isn't as large as we'd like, but we decided we needed to get an update in to your hands today regardless. So, what's new you ask? Let's take a look,

Firstly, you've got a new Helo on Nguyen Hue, the H-34, which replaces the UH-1D on that map.

[img]http://i.imgur.com/RMxkICi.jpg[/img]

If you don't recognize this helo, then you've never seen full metal jacket,
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=S06nIz4scvI

Let's take a look at the rest of the patch notes,
- The main HUD has been updated with a new artificial horizon.
- All 20mm and 23mm guns now cut off after 1-2 seconds of fire and have cooldown period of 1 second. This is the first step towards new ballistic weapon balancing.
- Grenade launchers on OH-6 and ACH-47 are now turreted as they should be
- The Mi-8MTV has lost its Falanga ATGM, this weapon system was replaced by UPK-23 gun pods.
- Mi-8TV has a new antenna block for ATGM targetting (and will have ATGM's in future)
- Mi-28 and Mi-28N rotor blades changed (were experimental version before, not mass-produced one)

Thanks to Vladislav Pakhomov for correcting us on Mi-8 and Mi-28 equipment.

We'd also like to show off some of the work our new level designer is doing in today's update, take a look!

[img]http://i.imgur.com/KZPM9ih.jpg [/img]

[img]http://i.imgur.com/IILHYv7.jpg [/img]

We'll have a lot more to start showcasing soon, so stay tuned for more!
-Rayne
TeamJetCat

notes.title: On 0.33, New Team Members and More
notes.notes:
Greetings Pilots!

Apologies that we've been a bit quiet this week, but it couldn't be helped as we had no real concreate information to share and showcase. Now that it's Friday and version 0.33 still isn't out yet, I figured it best to go ahead and at least give you something.

Firstly, on 0.33...

Version 0.33 is still in development, and it's been set back a little longer than we expected due to a few technical issues that have made us decide it's best not to update, than to give you a broken update. However, we're preping to get a test build up on our dedicate test server and give you all access to that so you can help us make it a better build overall. When that's coming I can't say for certain, but we're hoping to get you a new build by Monday.

On to new team members...

Our new programmer is slowly being integarated in to the team and has already hit the ground running and you should see some of his work in the next patch or two. We've finally also settled on a new level designer and modeler that wil both be helping create new content from helos to maps, etc.

A special side note...

-Rayne

notes.title: Heliborne month one on Steam. All is well!
notes.notes:
[img]http://www.jetcatgames.com/wp-content/uploads/2015/07/logo_temp1.png[/img]

[b]Team JetCat SITREP[/b]
Greetings Pilots! Rayne here from Team JetCat to give you an overview of our first month on steam early access, as well as some information on upcoming features, content, and updates. Let's start with the a full overview of TeamJetCat,

The first full month of sales have seen us hit close to the 12,000 Unit mark, which for a team like ours, is very successful, more so than we could have hoped for. This means that JetCatGames has enough operating revenue from the first month, as well as more funding from our investors,  to hire on four new team members, and cover the rest of the years development costs. The extra funding from our investors, for those curious, comes in part, because they are just as happy to see the concept proven and desired as we are. All of this, as a note, is thanks to all of you! Your support, feedback, and dedication to us and our project makes us smile daily. The whole team is happy, working hard, and dedicated to the months that are to come.

With the note of new-hires, we'd like to make mention that we are in talks with a new 3D modeling artist, a dedicated Level Designer, and two new programmers. The success of month one also allows some of our team to take on new and extended responsibilities as well. I myself will be moving to help support QA, Bug Fixing, Balance and even assisting with Level/Map Design as we move forward.

Overall, our first 30 days was a massive success! Thank you all!

[b]Heliborne Content Roadmap Update and SITREP[/b]
Heliborne itself has seen four consecutive weekly updates since launch, as well as a number of other fixes and smaller patches. This proves that we can maintain our goal of a weekly updates every Monday, and you can all expect this to continue through the coming months.

What's coming in the future? 
•	The Balkans Map - Dev Blog with Pictures and info to come this week!
•	The Deck Building/Squadron Building system
•	More Troop Types
•	Updates and changes to Frontlines Mode
•	Updates to the flight model

Check Our Roadmap here for more  - https://trello.com/b/ARkKWs5S/heliborne-feature-roadmap

Please keep your feedback, bug reports, and suggestions coming! 

[b]Community SITREP[/b]
TeamjetCat will be focusing more on our prime sites over the coming weeks, that means you can expect to see more content on our YouTube Channel, Twitch Channel, and Forums. If you want that content, please join us here:

forums.jetcatgames.com - Official Forums and Community Hub. Team JetCat wil be focusing our efforts here, this means we'll not be on steam as much, but you can still expect to see us around answering your questions. However, all future dev blogs, and content will come from and be on the forums. We can't wait to see you there!

https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCYIuKTH0BSFk5CjDNkVz7oA - The long link here will direct you to our YouTube channel, were you can expect to see new content over the coming weeks about Heliborne.

https://www.twitch.tv/jetcatgames - Our Twitch channel, were you can expect to see Dev Livecast Q&A sessions, as well as live development in the future.

On top of the above, please join us on Facebook and Twitter, 
Facebook - https://www.facebook.com/HeliborneGame
Twitter - @jetcatgames

[b]Upcoming Community Events[/b]
Heliborne Dev Days! Every Wednesday, all day, you'll see team JetCat online and playing the game with you! Spot us by the purple chat color in chat. Feel free to ask us questions, talk to us about the game, etc

There's more coming in this area as well, 
Rayne Team JetCat

[img]https://pbs.twimg.com/profile_images/600386712036986881/YjQWOMdy.png[/img]

notes.title: Team JetCat is hiring!
notes.notes:
Hello Everyone!

Our first few weeks on Steam Early access has been very successful. As we climbed up to the 10,000 Copies mark, we  decided it was time to expand the team! We are now looking for programmers and 3D artists. If you're looking to be a part of something with a great deal of potential, and build something alongside the rest of Team JetCat and our amazing community, then we'd love to have you. As a note, we can offer relocation to Vilnius and bonuses.

If your curious what the project is, let us tell you...

Heliborne, is a multiplayer, tactical arcade game, focused around Rotary aviation and combat and giving the players a chance to feel like real pilots flying a support role in an active and dynamic battlefield. Heliborne also offers a players a chance to interact with ground forces in a large-scale and meaningful way. The project is built on the Unity Platform.

Job Requirements for Programmers across three fields,
Unity Engine and Graphics
-Project Optimization
-Visual Effects design.
-Shader implementation and design.
-Understanding of Modern Graphics Technologies
-Unity Engine Game Physics design and programming.


Networking and Game Logic
-Game Logic design and programming.
-AI Programming
-Netcode and Network programming.

General Experience with Unity and a working knowledge of it, as well as some previous development experience with Unity (the more the better) is required. We are a small team, and this means that you will be participating in the full development cycle, addressing a wide range of tasks alongside the rest of the team.

We are also looking for a 3D/2D artist with the following skillset,
-Modeling of low and high-poly count objects, mostly vehicles ranging from Helicopters to ground vehicles.
-Experience with 3DSMax and Photoshop
-User Interface Design (2D Art)

Finally, we're looking for a Level Designer with the following skillset,
-Experience with Unity Terrain and Modeling
-Design and Texturing of low and high-poly count objects

Above all else, Experience with and a passion for the theme of Military and Heritage vehicle combat genre is very welcomed and desired. 

If you are interested, please contact us directly at contact@jetcatgames.com

Thank you for your interest and we look forward to hearing from you.
-Team JetCat

notes.title: Version 0.27 "Fair Play"
notes.notes:
[img]http://www.jetcatgames.com/wp-content/uploads/2015/07/logo_temp1.png[img]

- Collision detection model of all helicopters redone.

- Teamkillers are now kicked from the room and bared from re-entry. (We will monitor and adjust this over the coming days, expect a seconardy patch in a few days.)

- Several small bug fixes

Next week's update will also see some new content on top of our current performance focus. Stay tuned for more!
-Rayne
Team JetCat

notes.title: Version 0.24 Update and More!
notes.notes:
[img]http://www.jetcatgames.com/wp-content/uploads/2015/07/logo_temp1.png[/img]

Greetings pilots! Today's a big one, so let's get to it shall we?

First off, We've updated the game to version 0.24. Patch notes follow,

[list]
[*]Version 1 of the OIS or the "Opponent Identification System" is now in place. This system is work in progress, and future updates will improve upon this first version. The OIS now changes the distance at which the "marker" above a Helicopter is detected by the player based on distance and altitude. Enemies are always ID'ed at 250 Meters. Maximum ID distance is now 750 meters.
[*]Ballistic trajectory version 1 added to unguided rockets. Visual effects changed slightly. Missile flight dynamics will continue to be updated in the future.
[*]Acceleration with nose up, and Decceleration with nose down pitch increased for all helicopters.
[*]All helicopters are now slightly faster in forward flight
[*]All helicopters now respond to "collective" lowering faster, this translates to faster decent speeds for all Helicopters.
[*]Markers above the friendly boats are back.
[*]Boats on Tonkin were weakened (accuracy and lethality of weapons)
[*]Improvement of lag compensation ( we will continue to work on this)
[*]Bug with unkillable AA guns fixed, as well as bug with uncapturing points (when it was marked as captured by the enemy, although there was no any ground troops) fixed.
[*]UI bugs fixed: no choosing server buttons in 4:3 aspect ration, freezing screen after disconnection from server or attempt to enter a full room.
[*]Helicopters crashed nearby the initial bases disappear faster
[*]Entering match in Camera mode temporarily removed
[/list]

[h1]*NOTE* You will need to close the game and apply the update. The next update will be a normal server restart with a server wide message.[/h1]


Next, we're moving to new forums! The old SMF forums are being shut down, and we have launched new forums here,

forums.jetcatgames.com

Registration is open to ALL, and automatic. So head on over! They're live with this announcement.


Moving on, the first week has gone well! Heliborne has reached over 5,000 copies sold! We can't thank you all enough for your feedback and support. We couldn't do this without you.

Additionally,
JetCatGames is now reaching out for a new programmer and 3D Artist. If you're interested, please send your resume/CV and portfolio to contact@jetcatgames.com


Last but not least,
With the closure of the Alpha Forums and the opening of the new Public forums, as well as this current update, the Heliborne Alpha is now closing. This means that to continue to play the current version of Heliborne, you will need to purchase it via Steam.

To all our Alpha Testers, thank you so much for your dedication, interest, and support!
-Team JetCat

just a quick update for you today that I'm ceratin is going to be welcomed by our non-english community and our friends from down-under.

Czech 
French
German
Spanish

Thank you all for your support as always, and stay tuned for more!
-Rayne JCG

notes.title: Greetings Pilots!
notes.notes:
Welcome to Heliborne Early Access, my name is "Rayne" and I'm your Communty Manager, at least for you english speaking folks. My partner Illia Lahunou (mindoug) will be focusing his efforts on our Russian speaking audience and our non-english EU friends as we move forward.

So, now that we've live, what can you expect from us?

*Updates several times a week, to weekly at worst case conditions.
*New features being added such as our progression system, ground forces interaction, etc
*New Helicopters being added
*New maps and Game modes are coming!
*More servers to support those regions with issues connecting..

And more!

Today's go-live patch features the following,
-Fixed Steam-Login Issue
-US Server Online
-Verticle Mouse Invert Option
-No missile alert voice on non-soviet helis

Also, we're keeping our Free alpha version up for just a few more days, to make sure that you all get a chance to play, test, and decide if you want to support us.

To those of you that are, or have supported us allready, we can't thank you enough!

Fly Safe Pilots!
-Rayne
